description: This file defines a Helper class with static utility methods for URL processing, rectangle and size calculations, event handling, logging, and log formatting, used within the Playwright core server code.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URL handling, geometry calculations, event waiting, logging, and log formatting.

methods.name: completeUserURL
methods.description: Completes a URL string by prepending 'http://' if it starts with 'localhost' or '127.0.0.1'.

methods.name: enclosingIntRect
methods.description: Calculates the smallest enclosing integer rectangle for a given rectangle.

methods.name: enclosingIntSize
methods.description: Calculates the smallest enclosing integer size for a given size.

methods.name: getViewportSizeFromWindowFeatures
methods.description: Extracts viewport size from window features array.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on an EventEmitter with optional predicate, returning a promise and dispose function.

methods.name: secondsToRoundishMillis
methods.description: Converts seconds to a rounded milliseconds value.

methods.name: millisToRoundishMillis
methods.description: Rounds milliseconds to a consistent value.

methods.name: debugProtocolLogger
methods.description: Creates a protocol logger function that logs sent and received messages, with optional truncation.

methods.name: formatBrowserLogs
methods.description: Formats browser logs with optional disconnect reason.
